section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1969
title: 6 Table 2 presents the number of accidental deaths during 1964 to 1969. The number of accidental deaths increased very sharply from 1964 to 1965 i.e. an increase of 16.0%, and from 1965 to 1966 it increased by 9.4%. After 1966 the average rate of growth of accidental deaths was 1.9%. and the overall increase from 1966 to 1969 was 7.5%. The survey of accidental deaths and suicides in the country was started from 1964. The low incidence of accidental deaths during 1964 and 1965 may be due to incomplete statistics.
